notes.title: The Toppling Cup
notes.content: [h3]Take on [b]The Toppling Cup[/b] from October 10 to 21![/h3][p]The seas are shifting—who will stay upright, and who will topple? Compete for free yacht skin packs in a thrilling bracketed tournament with leaderboards that reset every few days so every sailor, from ballasts to skippers will have their shot at glory.[/p][p]Participation is simple: just complete at least [b]3 online fleet races[/b] to enter![/p][hr][/hr][h2]Schedule[/h2][p]The Toppling Cup follows a [b]6-round bracketed format[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Bracket 1:[/b] Finish in the [b]top 30%[/b] of your Bracket 1 leaderboard to keep your balance and advance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bracket 2:[/b] Secure a [b]top 3 finish[/b] during a [b]Qualifying Heat[/b] to move forward.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bracket 3:[/b] Hold your course to claim a place on the [b]Toppling Cup Final Leaderboard[/b] during [b]Round 6[/b]![/p][/*][/list][p]Didn’t make it to Bracket 3 by the end of Round 5? Don’t worry sailors in Brackets 1 and 2 can still compete for the [b]Legends Cup[/b] in Round 6.[/p][p]In the finals (Round 6), only the strongest sailors who don’t capsize under pressure will claim the Cup. [b]Top 3 positions win[/b]![/p][p]Each round begins at [b]2am CET[/b] and ends at [b]11pm CET the following day[/b] (45-hour duration).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898670/a6b45f6939d84ecebe18896a171cd4ac81cd5e54.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Prizes[/h2][p]🏆 [b]The Toppling Cup (Bracket 3 Finalists):[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]1st, 2nd, and 3rd place[/b] finishers will receive:[/p][list][*][p]A free yacht skin[/p][/*][*][p]A virtual trophy to commemorate victory[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The [b]winner[/b] will also earn the exclusive in-game title: [i]“Toppling Cup Champion”[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]🏅 [b]Legends Cup (Brackets 1 & 2 Finalists):[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]1st, 2nd, and 3rd place[/b] finishers will receive:[/p][list][*][p]A yacht skin[/p][/*][*][p]A special in-game title (e.g. [i]Legends Cup Champion[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]A virtual trophy[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Additionally, [b]all players who reach Bracket 3[/b] will automatically earn a trophy and the in-game title [i]“Toppling Cup Finalist”[/i][/p]

notes.title: The Leading Edge Cup
notes.content:
[b]Take on the Leading Edge Cup from the 11th to 22nd of May![/b]
Win slick designs for your yacht in a bracketed structure with leaderboards which reset every couple days giving sailors of all levels a chance to compete and an opportunity to win.

[b]Simply race in at least 3 online fleet races to participate![/b]

[h2]Schedule[/h2]
The Leading Edge Cup is a bracketed tournament with 6 rounds. Advance to the next bracket by placing in the top 40% of players in the leaderboard for your bracket each round. Every race counts!

Make it into Bracket 4 to secure your place in the Leading Edge Cup final leaderboard during round 6! However, if you don’t make it to bracket 4 by the end of round 5 you can still compete for the "Legends Cup" in round 6 with the other players in your bracket.

The finals work identically to earlier rounds, however only the top finishers (Top 3 positions for the Leading Edge Cup, and top spot for the Legends Cup) will be awarded the cup.

Rounds will start at 12am CET and end at 10pm CET the following day (46 hour duration)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898670/e0a1818f7af571a96f73b6a64fe3e4bb99336135.png[/img]

[h2]Prizes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]The winner of the Legends Cup and the Leading Edge Cup will receive a free yacht skin, in-game title (i.e. "Legends Cup Champion") and a virtual trophy to acknowledge their victory!
[*]2nd and 3rd place finishers of the Leading Edge Cup will receive a free yacht skin, title and virtual trophy.
[*]All players that make it to Bracket 4 will receive a randomly selected in-game title.
[/list]

notes.title: America's Cup E-Series
notes.content:
Introducing the America's Cup e-Series, the newest addition to the esports calendar that brings the excitement and precision of competitive yacht racing to the virtual world. Played on AC Sailing®, the ultimate sailing simulation videogame created by the Louis Vuitton 37th America's Cup, this inaugural season promises to be a nail-biting experience for even the most seasoned players.

The championship will commence on July 31st, leading up to the on-the-water action, and culminate in a Grand Final event in Barcelona on September 28th, where eight players will go head-to-head to be crowned the first-ever America's Cup e-Series champion.

[previewyoutube=g-t2hLFT1xU;full][/previewyoutube]

The America's Cup e-Series offers players worldwide a unique chance to test their skills against the best, shine on a truly global stage, and carve their name in the annals of America's Cup history. So, what are you waiting for? Register today and start leveling up your gameplay before the start of the season.

The America’s Cup e-Series is comprised by two main phases: the Online Qualifiers and the Grand Final.

The Online Qualifiers is the public qualification phase and consists of six rounds online events. Each round features a weekly challenge that spans from Wednesday to Tuesday, where players can participate in races to earn qualifying points. Additionally, each round includes a Playoff Final, which takes place on the following Saturday, where the top eight players of the week will race against each other to secure a seat in the Grand Final.

The Grand Final will feature the six finalists and two wildcard players, who will compete in Barcelona for a slice of an impressive € 50,000 prize pool. However, only one will be crowned as the first-ever America’s Cup e-Series champion.

The America's Cup e-Series isn't just about digital dominance, it's about blurring the lines between virtual and real. AC Sailing is so incredibly realistic that we're giving our top players the chance to take their skills from the screen to the water, stepping onto a real AC40 yacht!

After the Grand Final, the top two finishers will embark on an incredible journey. They'll undergo two days of intensive training, mastering their skills and learning the ropes of real-world sailing. Then, they'll face off
against a Unicredit Youth America's Cup team on the waters of Barcelona, putting their virtual expertise to the true test.

It's the ultimate showdown: gamer versus sailors. Will our virtual champions prove that the skills honed through gaming can lead to success on the open water? Don’t miss this epic battle as we redefine the boundaries of sports and gaming.

[url=https://www.americascup.com/e-series]More Information[/url]

notes.title: v1.0.5 Input and Scoring - Release Notes
notes.content:
Version 1.0.5 is now out, just in time for the weekend!

[h1]Input[/h1]
[list]
[*] New system allowing the use of any USB device (controller / wheels). Toggle option to switch between gamepad and other USB device
[*] Custom bindings for all devices
[*] Xbox / PlayStation controllers should work automatically when not toggled onto other USB
[*] Mouse steering option for keyboard & mouse (Toggle in settings)
[/list]
[h1]Race scoring[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fleet race score reset (Previous scores are still stored which we may display later)
[*] New scoring system. Base score for a win/loss is 20/-20 (changes depending on your position in a fleet race). This can scale based of opponent level to a max of +/- 5 from the base score. The previous system allowed scaling to go to zero which was    contributing to gaining very little points or none at the top of the leaderboard
[*] Fixed an issue of multiple score updates at the end of a race
[*] Players who quit a match before the end of a race will be penalized -40 points on the leaderboard
[/list]
[h1]Penalties[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed ghost boat penalties when a player left a match
[*] Fixed penalties after crossing the finish line
[*] Reduced the time you can cross the start from 5 seconds to 3 seconds
[*] The wind penalty applied to your yacht has been increased to reduce your wind by 30% from 20%
[/list]
[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where online race course could be changed by a player
[*] Fixed issue of flying yacht when disconnected
[*] Fixed issue with quick match button double input
[*] Fixed an issue where on some collisions one player could be teleported back to the starting area
[*] Fixed resetting yacht issues in the tutorials
[*] Improvement to loading assets
[*] Small performance improvements
[*] More detailed information on an error where people fail to load a dependant library
[/list]

[b]To keep you updated on what is coming next, here is some of the tasks we are working on:[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Spectator Camera
[*] Replay save / load
[*] Collisions handling when you are not at fault and ensuring you get less of a disadvantage
[*] E-Series (more information to come!)
[/list]

Disabled mark zone penalties on the start gate
Fixed non-positional audio and effects of other yachts playing for the local player
Updated AC Sailing yacht default sailor gear design
Fixed rotation controls of post race spectator camera
Improved matchmaking consistency

notes.title: v1.0.3 Matchmaking and Loading - Change List
notes.content:
Improved fleet race matchmaking. Races will now allow participants late entry, increasing frequency of multi yacht fleets.
Fixed flag image loading. Flags will no longer reset to New Zealand and should stay loaded.
Improved sailor model optimization.
Optimized yacht and sailor load. (More soon to come)
Tutorial improvements.
Adjusted course wind conditions to center around base wind more evenly.
Yacht skin resetting fixes. Skins should now load correctly on return to menu.
Fixed race not starting if player joins late. Late connections were stopping some races from starting. most cases of this should now be fixed.
Fixed players being removed from private session on return to menu.
Improvements to players' competitive race ranking calculation.

notes.title: Minor update notes (v1.0.1)
notes.content:
- Added 9 new course and weather configurations to online matchmaking modes
- Added minimap replay animation to end of race screen

- Fixed key bindings not persisting when launching the game
- Fixed key binds not mapping to some keys
- Fixed matchmaking repeating connection attempts to a single match
- Fixed Quick Match and Fleet Mode matchmaking buttons behaving differently
- Fixed Matchmaking canceling on failed connection attempt
